title_original: The Art of Light: Lumenocity comes back

blocks.text: The Art of Light brings South African light installations to the gardens of Norval Foundation in Cape Town, from 20 to 29 November 2026.

As daylight fades over Cape Town, the gardens of Norval Foundation will become a setting for artistic encounters with light, space and the natural environment. ‘The Art of Light’ brings a selection of installations from LUMENOCITY to Tokai, giving visitors the chance to experience works by South African artists in a new setting.

Moving beyond their original urban context, the installations will be presented among trees, lawns and winding pathways, inviting audiences to consider how light transforms familiar landscapes and alters our perception of space.

Rather than a conventional gallery exhibition, ‘The Art of Light’ unfolds as an outdoor journey. Visitors can explore the illuminated installations at their own pace, with the experience taking approximately 60 to 90 minutes.

The presentation offers an opportunity to encounter contemporary artistic practices beyond the museum’s interior, where the relationship between artwork, environment and audience becomes central to the experience.
Suitable for all ages, the event will also feature food trucks and refreshments, creating an accessible evening of art and exploration.
This event will take place at the Norval Foundation in Tokai, from 20 to 29 November 2026, excluding 23 and 24 November.
